capabilities: Sync all lessons of one cachly Brain
Write one Markdown note per lesson with frontmatter fields
Generate an overview note listing lessons by category
Archive lessons that no longer exist in cachly
Run automatic sync every 15 or 60 minutes
disambiguation: Not a local cache or backup; it only pulls lessons from a cachly Brain into notes.
extras: Sync is one-way: lesson notes in the vault are overwritten at each sync, and edits must be made in cachly. The API key is stored in plain text in the plugin data file. A free plan exists, and lessons are stored on servers in Germany.
problem: What a team's AI coding tools learn about a project stays inside each vendor's memory and cannot be read, searched or linked in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: fetch all lessons of one cachly Brain

summary: One-way sync that pulls lessons from a cachly Brain into a vault folder as Markdown notes, one per lesson.
